column1: # One mission work order per line: a discovery label, one tab, the discovery
# title from missions/README.md. Blank lines and lines starting with '#'
# This list is the frozen denominator of `cs_content::campaign_bindings`:
# coverage counts every declared mission exactly once, and no code path
# removes one. A line that is not exactly `label<TAB>title`, a blank title, a
# malformed label or a repeated label fails the whole file, so a broken edit
# cannot drop a mission silently. Discovered missions beyond this list are
# recorded as well and stay visible as `discovered_extra` in the report.
# The labels are discovery labels from the public guide, not verified retail
# Binding a mission to its original catalog id is M01-A … M24-A / F50-B work;
# `docs/findings/missions/` records what this file does and does not prove.
